proofs_written_and_reviewed.content: Low rotation-degree Jacobian recovery using known sector results; linear integrability criterion; projective uniqueness; nonintegrable quadratic complete-intersection example.

For cubic threefolds, pure ordinary-HKR bivectors restrict to zero in HH2(Ku); Todd correction treated explicitly. Consequence for a reconstructed family requires the stated KS and restriction compatibility.
Known Mori-Smith Hessian identity in the present conventions; split-block candidate using the existing elliptic comparison; nonzero second-order discrepancy with commuting the central expression.
Universal central cubic and all Artin PBW; smooth iff lambda^3 != -3; character calculations. The second coefficient and residual comparison are now determined in the separate new sections.
Finite bounded-arity curved bar isomorphisms and inverses extend to arbitrary finite-rank twisted matrices; strict units, internal shift, periodicity and all Artin flow bounds are checked.

Dito second-order star product, Weyl symmetrization, distinct Shoikhet tangent-wheel vanishing, specified center image F+h^2 H_active/24, MF equivalence and low rotation multiplication. c(lambda)=1/3+lambda^3/36.

Full Hochschild formality including normalized units and weight components, actual inverse center map, constant trivector from the regular gradient Koszul complex, all Artin and degreewise-complete finite-rank MF pair equivalence. No single-block assumption.

Ambient-perfect relative singularity quotient; enhanced stabilization via exact dg quotients and finite totalization; Artin line-bundle and MF Hom base change; Ind-category generator lifting; finite window and rotation; Gamma_R Artin comparison; perfect commutative residual pair reconstruction.

Known P1 degeneration of a generator, explicit rank-four proper dg family, smooth special fiber and all Artin cuts but nonsmooth generic fiber; infinite derived-tensor proof. This does not disprove the specified cubic Gamma or a cohomology-flat variant.

Elementary sufficient condition: a finite free ordinary algebra over C[[h]] with smooth special fiber is relatively smooth, by idempotent lifting and R-split kernels. This does not establish smoothness for the current positive-cohomology A-infinity model.

Argument for G-equivariant formality including averaging semilinear PBW markings, swap involution tau:(x,y,h)->(y,x,-h), and all-order formal GL5 normal form F_{lambda_*(h^6)}+h^2 c_*(h^6) xyz. Finite character/Jacobian and free-algebra identities checked with exact SymPy; the formality argument itself has not been independently formally verified or externally refereed.

Conditional local algebraization preserving finite jets and formal linear equivalence; DVR saturation algorithm; commutative mixed-template products, integrability rank minor and smoothness polynomial. Full mathematical proof written; not independently externally refereed.
